021import net.tnemc.core.TNECore;
022import net.tnemc.core.account.Account;
023import net.tnemc.core.account.SharedAccount;
024import net.tnemc.core.account.holdings.HoldingsEntry;
025import net.tnemc.plugincore.PluginCore;
026import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.id.UUIDPair;
027
028import com.palmergames.bukkit.towny.TownyAPI;
029import com.palmergames.bukkit.towny.TownySettings;
030import com.palmergames.bukkit.towny.object.Nation;
031import com.palmergames.bukkit.towny.object.Town;
032
033import java.util.Iterator;
034import java.util.List;
035import java.util.Map;
036import java.util.Optional;
037import java.util.UUID;
038
039/**
040 * TownyHandler
041 *
042 * @author creatorfromhell
043 * @since 0.1.2.0
044 */
045public class TownyHandler {
046
047  public static void addTypes() {
048
049    TNECore.eco().account().addAccountType(TownAccount.class, new TownCheck().check());
050    TNECore.eco().account().addAccountType(NationAccount.class, new NationCheck().check());
051  }
052
053  public static void synchronizeAccounts() {
054
055    final Iterator<Map.Entry<UUID, UUIDPair>> idIterator = TNECore.eco().account().uuidProvider().pairs().entrySet().iterator();
056    while(idIterator.hasNext()) {
057
058      final Map.Entry<UUID, UUIDPair> entry = idIterator.next();
059      final String name = entry.getValue().getUsername();
060
061      if(name.contains(TownySettings.getTownAccountPrefix())) {
062        synchronizeTown(entry, idIterator, name);
063      } else if(entry.getValue().getUsername().contains(TownySettings.getNationAccountPrefix())) {
064        synchronizeNation(entry, idIterator, name);
065      }
066    }
067  }
068
069  private static void synchronizeTown(final Map.Entry<UUID, UUIDPair> entry,
070                                      final Iterator<Map.Entry<UUID, UUIDPair>> idIterator,
071                                      final String name) {
072
073    final Town town = TownyAPI.getInstance().getTown(name.replace(TownySettings.getTownAccountPrefix(), ""));
074    if(town == null) {
075      removeStaleAccount("town", name, entry.getKey());
076      return;
077    }
078    repairIdentifier(entry, idIterator, name, "town", town.getUUID());
079  }
080
081  private static void synchronizeNation(final Map.Entry<UUID, UUIDPair> entry,
082                                        final Iterator<Map.Entry<UUID, UUIDPair>> idIterator,
083                                        final String name) {
084
085    final Nation nation = TownyAPI.getInstance().getNation(name.replace(TownySettings.getNationAccountPrefix(), ""));
086    if(nation == null) {
087      removeStaleAccount("nation", name, entry.getKey());
088      return;
089    }
090    repairIdentifier(entry, idIterator, name, "nation", nation.getUUID());
091  }
092
093  private static void removeStaleAccount(final String type, final String name, final UUID identifier) {
094
095    PluginCore.log().inform("Removing stale Towny " + type + " account: " + name);
096    TNECore.eco().account().deleteAccount(identifier);
097  }
098
099  private static void repairIdentifier(final Map.Entry<UUID, UUIDPair> entry,
100                                       final Iterator<Map.Entry<UUID, UUIDPair>> idIterator,
101                                       final String name, final String type, final UUID townyUUID) {
102
103    final Optional<Account> account = TNECore.eco().account().findAccount(entry.getKey().toString());
104    if(townyUUID.equals(entry.getKey()) || account.isEmpty()) {
105      return;
106    }
107
108    PluginCore.log().inform("Repairing Towny " + type + " UUID mismatch for: " + name
109                            + ". Old UUID: " + entry.getKey() + ", New UUID: " + townyUUID + '.');
110    final List<HoldingsEntry> holdings = account.get().getWallet().entryList();
111    idIterator.remove();
112    TNECore.eco().account().deleteAccount(entry.getKey());
113
114    final Optional<SharedAccount> response = TNECore.eco().account().createNonPlayerAccount(townyUUID.toString(), name);
115    response.ifPresent(sharedAccount->holdings.forEach(sharedAccount::setHoldings));
116  }
117}
